description: Fail-closed inventory of every runtime or collector root required before lua_rust may sweep a live VM.

provenance_audit.implemented: GcRef carries a process-global non-reused ObjectId; each collector validates address, ObjectId, and concrete tag in an authoritative live table. LightUserdata is a separate arbitrary-pointer type, and collector explicit roots retain erased pointer + ObjectId + tag handles.
provenance_audit.remaining_sweep_blocker: Safe Value::String equality and hashing still preserve byte-content semantics by dereferencing without a collector borrow. Direct production GcString creation prevents an unproven switch to identity semantics. Transitional unsafe GcRef::as_ref call sites, missing temporary roots, and the absent unique Heap owner also keep live sweep disabled.

owner.current: GarbageCollector stores erased pointer + ObjectId + concrete tag root handles; ObjectId is process-global and never reused.
owner.target: Heap owns scoped RootToken entries with HeapId and generation validation.

tracer.current: begin_mark_only validates every root's address, ObjectId, and tag against the collector live table before header access, then reports rejected roots without dereference.
tracer.target: RuntimeRootTracer seeds validated collector roots and labels them with RootKind.

root_kinds.missing_risk: Address-reuse provenance is closed for collector roots, but storage remains unscoped and is not yet a Heap-owned lexical RootToken; temporary-publication roots and the unique Heap lifetime are still missing.

planned_test.name: mark_only_seed_rejects_unregistered_explicit_root_without_dereference; address_reuse_injection_rejects_old_object_id_at_same_pointer
planned_test.assertion: A registered explicit root is marked, foreign/stale roots are rejected before dereference, and a stale ObjectId cannot validate when the same address is test-injected with a replacement identity.

owner.current: Runtime owns the canonical global-root GcRef, registers it as a collector root, and reachable LuaState values copy the handle.
owner.target: Runtime::GlobalRoots owns one validated global-table handle.

tracer.current: Runtime::trace_roots_mark_only marks both the Runtime global root and every reachable state's global_table.
tracer.target: RuntimeRootTracer always traces GlobalRoots::global_table.

root_kinds.missing_risk: The handles still lack heap generation validation and destructive/full/incremental collection is not wired to this mark-only tracer.

planned_test.name: mark_only_traces_runtime_state_roots_and_excludes_retired_values
planned_test.assertion: Runtime and state global-table edges are black in the mark-only live set without changing object count.

owner.current: Each LuaState stores copyable table handles and stdlib code assigns them directly.
owner.target: LuaState owns validated handles and all assignments use VmContext root barriers.

tracer.current: The Runtime state snapshot marks thread_env and chunk_env for every StateHandle reached through the two-queue traversal.
tracer.target: StateTracer marks both environments for every reachable state.

root_kinds.missing_risk: Direct assignments still lack provenance checks/root barriers and destructive collection is intentionally disconnected.

planned_test.name: mark_only_traces_runtime_state_roots_and_excludes_retired_values
planned_test.assertion: Both main-state environment handles are marked by the canonical snapshot and absent retired roots remain white.

owner.current: Runtime owns one persistent registry table and installs its handle in the main LuaState; debug.getregistry is not migrated yet.
owner.target: GlobalRoots owns one fixed, persistent registry table per Runtime.

tracer.current: The mark-only tracer seeds Runtime::registry_root and scans registry handles in every reachable state.
tracer.target: RuntimeRootTracer marks GlobalRoots::registry in every collection.

root_kinds.missing_risk: debug.getregistry does not yet return the Runtime table and no destructive collection consumes the tracer.

planned_test.name: mark_only_traces_runtime_state_roots_and_excludes_retired_values
planned_test.assertion: Runtime and main-state registry handles are marked by the live-set traversal without object destruction.

owner.current: LuaState stores only nil, boolean, and number metatables, with direct assignments.
owner.target: GlobalRoots owns the complete ValueType-indexed primitive metatable set.

tracer.current: The mark-only state snapshot marks every installed nil, boolean, and number metatable.
tracer.target: RuntimeRootTracer marks every installed primitive metatable.

root_kinds.missing_risk: Only three primitive types have slots, assignments lack barriers, and destructive collection is not wired to the snapshot.

planned_test.name: mark_only_traces_runtime_state_roots_and_excludes_retired_values
planned_test.assertion: All three currently representable primitive metatables are marked in the live-set report.

owner.current: Runtime owns the boxed main state and registers its stable address as one external generational StateArena slot.
owner.target: StateArena owns the main slot and GlobalRoots stores its StateHandle.

tracer.current: Runtime::trace_roots_mark_only always seeds and validates main_state_handle before scanning state roots.
tracer.target: RuntimeRootTracer enqueues the main StateHandle before object propagation.

root_kinds.missing_risk: The main Box remains externally owned rather than arena-owned; explicit close now validates, detaches, advances or permanently retires its generation without wrap, and drops it, but live collection still lacks one arena-owned state model.

planned_test.name: mark_only_traces_runtime_state_roots_and_excludes_retired_values
planned_test.assertion: The report contains exactly the Runtime main handle and all roots reachable only through its state snapshot.

owner.current: A per-state current_thread handle and Thread caller links approximate execution state.
owner.target: GlobalRoots and Runtime::active_execution own validated running Thread/State handles.

tracer.current: Every validated reachable state publishes current_thread into the object queue; the API rejects any active execution borrow.
tracer.target: RuntimeRootTracer marks the running thread and enqueues every active StateHandle.

root_kinds.missing_risk: Runtime does not yet own a separate running-thread root stack and direct current_thread assignment lacks a barrier.

planned_test.name: mark_only_traces_runtime_state_roots_and_excludes_retired_values
planned_test.assertion: current_thread is marked and trace_roots_mark_only rejects a nonzero active-execution count.

owner.current: LuaState owns Stack and separate logical top/call-window metadata.
owner.target: The main StateArena slot owns one canonical logical stack window.

tracer.current: The mark-only state snapshot scans exactly 0..LuaState::top and reports top/Stack inconsistencies without reading past initialized values.
tracer.target: StateTracer marks the complete active window and nils retired slots.

root_kinds.missing_risk: Retired slots are excluded but not yet nilled; publication barriers and destructive collector integration remain absent.

planned_test.name: mark_only_traces_runtime_state_roots_and_excludes_retired_values
planned_test.assertion: An unnamed active temporary is marked while a copied value beyond logical top remains white.

owner.current: StateArena owns coroutine LuaState boxes and Thread stores a runtime/generation-validated StateHandle.
owner.target: StateArena owns the coroutine slot and Thread owns one generational StateHandle.

tracer.current: Each reachable Thread enqueues its StateHandle; arena membership alone is never seeded as a root, and state/object queues iterate to a fixed point.
tracer.target: Tracing a reachable Thread enqueues its state and caller-state handles.

root_kinds.missing_risk: Explicit Runtime close drains every coroutine state before heap teardown, but unreachable-state removal is still not integrated with live Thread sweep.

planned_test.name: mark_only_reaches_two_queue_fixed_point_without_rooting_arena_membership
planned_test.assertion: A reachable Thread-state-stack chain is marked across multiple queue turns while an occupied but unreachable arena state and its payload are absent.

owner.current: CallInfo stores a stack index; selected active frames mark the indexed Value.
owner.target: Each active frame has a validated function-slot contract traced by StateTracer.

tracer.current: The mark-only snapshot scans function slots only for CallInfo records through current_ci and reports out-of-bounds slots.
tracer.target: StateTracer marks every active frame function slot exactly once.

root_kinds.missing_risk: CallInfo still stores an unvalidated integer slot and destructive collection is not wired to the snapshot.

planned_test.name: mark_only_traces_runtime_state_roots_and_excludes_retired_values
planned_test.assertion: The active frame function is marked while an inactive frame's retained vararg does not enter the live set.

owner.current: Every active Lua CallInfo stores an ObjectId-bearing GcRef<Proto>; LuaState no longer duplicates a raw current_proto pointer, and popped/unwound frames clear Proto and varargs.
owner.target: Active frames retain the managed Proto handle through a unified VM execution context with scoped collector borrows.

tracer.current: The mark-only state snapshot marks each active CallInfo Proto handle directly, including pseudo-frames with no Function stack slot; stale or foreign handles are rejected by collector provenance checks.
tracer.target: The same canonical StateTracer feeds destructive collection at a proven safe point.

root_kinds.missing_risk: VM execution validates the handle before dereference but still uses a scoped unsafe borrow under the explicit no-destructive-sweep execution invariant; the canonical tracer is not yet wired to collection.

planned_test.name: active_call_info_proto_is_rooted_without_a_function_slot
planned_test.assertion: A managed active Proto is marked directly even when the active frame has no Function value in its function slot.

owner.current: Each CallInfo owns a Vec<Value> vararg snapshot.
owner.target: Active CallInfo owns varargs and reset frames clear all handles.

tracer.current: The mark-only snapshot scans varargs only for active CallInfo records through current_ci.
tracer.target: StateTracer scans only active frame varargs.

root_kinds.missing_risk: Inactive CallInfo reset/clearing and destructive collector integration remain incomplete.

planned_test.name: mark_only_traces_runtime_state_roots_and_excludes_retired_values
planned_test.assertion: An active vararg-only object is marked while a retained inactive-frame vararg remains white.

owner.current: LuaState owns a descending Vec<GcRef<Upvalue>>; each open Upvalue stores its checked StateHandle owner and stack index without intrusive successor or raw stack pointers.
owner.target: Reachable State owns the list; Upvalue stores StateHandle plus checked stack index.

tracer.current: State snapshots validate and mark every open Upvalue; propagation from a reachable open Upvalue enqueues its owner StateHandle, whose active stack window retains the indexed value.
tracer.target: StateTracer marks the list and its owner slots; state close converts every node before arena removal.

root_kinds.missing_risk: This root path is implemented and Runtime drain closes each validated Upvalue before owner generation advance or retirement. Live destructive collection remains blocked by other inventory gaps, publication migration, and write-barrier/finalizer work.

planned_test.name: reachable_open_upvalue_enqueues_its_owner_state_without_a_thread_edge
planned_test.assertion: A closure-reachable open Upvalue enqueues its owner state without a Thread edge and marks the indexed stack value with no unsafe gap.

owner.current: Thread stores a caller GcRef and one generational StateHandle; no caller-state raw pointer remains.
owner.target: Thread stores validated caller Thread and StateHandle edges.

tracer.current: Object tracing marks caller Thread edges, and every reached Thread independently enqueues its validated StateHandle.
tracer.target: ObjectTracer marks caller and enqueues caller_state.

root_kinds.missing_risk: GcRef caller provenance remains unchecked and close/sweep ordering is not implemented.

planned_test.name: mark_only_reaches_two_queue_fixed_point_without_rooting_arena_membership
planned_test.assertion: A two-Thread graph reports its caller edge and reaches both states across the object/state fixed point.

owner.current: LuaState stores a Value and stdlib assigns it directly.
owner.target: Reachable State owns the hook and assignment uses a root barrier.

tracer.current: The mark-only snapshot marks debug_hook for every reachable state and scans the complete active stack window.
tracer.target: StateTracer always marks it and uses a wide stack window while a hook is active.

root_kinds.missing_risk: Hook assignment lacks a root barrier and real collection remains disconnected from this tracer.

planned_test.name: mark_only_traces_runtime_state_roots_and_excludes_retired_values
planned_test.assertion: The hook Value and active unnamed temporaries are both marked by the state snapshot.

owner.current: LuaState stores an ObjectId-bearing GcRef<Proto> for one-shot hook line suppression and clears it immediately after the matching instruction.
owner.target: Debug state uses a validated frame/Proto identity scoped by the owning Runtime.

tracer.current: The mark-only state snapshot marks debug_hook_skip_proto directly; debug inspection validates Proto handles against the owning collector before dereference.
tracer.target: The canonical StateTracer feeds destructive collection at a proven safe point.

root_kinds.missing_risk: Destructive collection remains disabled during debug callbacks, and debug Proto reads still use validated transitional unsafe borrows rather than a scoped Heap/VmContext API.

planned_test.name: debug_line_skip_is_one_shot_and_matches_full_object_identity
planned_test.assertion: A same-line different-ObjectId Proto does not consume the skip; the matching managed Proto consumes it once and the next instruction is no longer suppressed.

owner.current: LuaState owns a Vec<Value> populated by coroutine.yield.
owner.target: The coroutine StateArena slot owns and clears yielded values through VmContext.

tracer.current: The mark-only snapshot marks all yielded_values for every reachable state.
tracer.target: StateTracer marks yielded values for every reachable suspended state.

root_kinds.missing_risk: Mutation barriers and destructive collector integration are still missing.

planned_test.name: mark_only_traces_runtime_state_roots_and_excludes_retired_values
planned_test.assertion: An object reachable only from yielded_values is black in the mark-only live set.

owner.current: LuaState stores an Option<Value> assigned directly by coroutine code.
owner.target: Reachable State owns last_error and assignment uses a root barrier.

tracer.current: The mark-only snapshot marks last_error for every reachable state.
tracer.target: StateTracer marks the error until it is explicitly cleared.

root_kinds.missing_risk: Assignment/clear barriers and destructive collector integration are still missing.

planned_test.name: mark_only_traces_runtime_state_roots_and_excludes_retired_values
planned_test.assertion: An object reachable only through last_error is black in the mark-only live set.

owner.current: GarbageCollector stores GcRef<Userdata> entries carrying ObjectId; finalizer entry points are still split between a stub and a compatibility path.
owner.target: Heap owns a validated finalizer queue whose entries remain roots through protected callback completion.

tracer.current: Collector mark does not seed pending_finalizers; queue membership is identity-aware, central destroy_object prunes entries before drop, and Runtime close reports then discards the remaining queue without Lua callbacks.
tracer.target: RuntimeRootTracer marks every pending entry and central destruction prunes it before free.

root_kinds.missing_risk: Address-reuse aliasing is closed, but pending entries are not canonical roots; reentrant/error paths can still skip later finalizers or free the finalizer closure graph.

planned_test.name: persistent_queues_do_not_reidentify_reused_addresses; pending_finalizers_are_rooted_pruned_and_drained
planned_test.assertion: A replacement allocation at the same address is not inherited by the old queue identity; future reentrant/erroring finalizers all run once and close ends with an empty queue.

owner.current: GarbageCollector::with_publication provides a higher-ranked PublicationTxn and branded Rooted handle. New allocations enter an ObjectId-bearing temporary-root registry before the handle is exposed; panic/nested-scope Drop removes exact identities, and safe raw-handle escape is limited to promotion into the explicit collector root set.
owner.target: Heap owns publication transactions with typed Table/Function/Proto/Userdata edge-publish operations and makes unprotected production allocation unavailable.

tracer.current: GarbageCollector::begin_mark_only validates and seeds active temporary object roots, with separate seeded/rejected counts.
tracer.target: RuntimeRootTracer seeds every active temporary-root scope.

root_kinds.missing_risk: The registry/API foundation is tested, but compiler, IO, coroutine, library registration, VM temporaries, result Vecs, and direct production gc.create calls have not migrated. Allocation-triggered collection therefore remains disabled.

planned_test.name: allocation_is_seeded_until_transaction_drop; nested_and_panic_scopes_release_exact_roots; allocation_during_object_construction_preserves_temporaries
planned_test.assertion: The foundation seeds exact temporary identities and returns to zero after 1,000 scopes; future forced-GC-at-every-allocation tests must preserve compiler, IO, coroutine, and closure construction intermediates.

owner.current: Coroutine creation now allocates the Thread and installs State -> Thread before arena insertion, then binds Thread -> StateHandle before exposing the Thread value. The intermediate Thread/state pair is still unreachable and has neither a PendingState rollback guard nor a temporary state root.
owner.target: Runtime publication owns a branded PendingState that rolls the arena slot back unless State-to-Thread publication commits.

tracer.current: Arena membership is intentionally not a root and there is no temporary state-root queue.
tracer.target: RuntimeRootTracer seeds validated temporary StateHandles independently from temporary GC-object roots.

root_kinds.missing_risk: A future allocation-triggered state prepass can close the unreachable inserted state before Thread publication, and an allocation/panic boundary can still leave an unreachable Thread or occupied slot without transactional rollback.

planned_test.name: pending_state_rolls_back_or_publishes_atomically
planned_test.assertion: GC/failure injection between arena insertion, Thread allocation, binding, and stack publication either preserves the state through commit or removes the slot and advances/retire its generation exactly once.

owner.current: RuntimeHeap owns every active ResumeRequest, deferred native frame, caller/target Thread edge, continuation snapshot, and pending response until delivery. NativeActivationSessionGuard restores links and drains the buffer on success, error, or panic.
owner.target: The unique Heap owner exposes the same activation buffer as a canonical root provider to full and incremental collection.

tracer.current: NativeActivationStack::seed_roots marks request arguments, Thread handles, caller Proto, saved stack/call-frame values, yielded/error values, and pending responses at every state-turn boundary before the next state is borrowed.
tracer.target: RuntimeRootTracer labels activation-buffer edges and invokes the provider during every stop-the-world and incremental root seed.

root_kinds.missing_risk: Live destructive collection remains disabled. Before enabling it, the collector entry point must call this provider as part of the canonical root seed rather than relying only on the current turn-boundary seed.

planned_test.name: runtime_native_activation_roots_survive_switch_delivery_and_unwind
planned_test.assertion: Request arguments, continuation values, pending results/errors, and caller/target Threads remain marked while peak borrowed StateArena slots stays one; success, VM error, and panic all leave the activation buffer empty.

owner.current: IO resources live in graph-owned Userdata and typed access is confined to HRTB callbacks over an explicitly aligned payload.
owner.target: Object graphs or explicit runtime RootToken values own every live library handle; access is scoped by VmContext.

tracer.current: There is no inventory-backed library root provider; correctness depends on informal stack/table comments.
tracer.target: ObjectTracer follows graph-owned handles and RuntimeRootTracer labels any explicit service cache root.

root_kinds.missing_risk: Runtime close runs Rust typed payload destructors, but library-specific Lua close hooks and a complete inventory-backed service-root provider remain absent.

planned_test.name: library_resources_follow_graph_lifetime_and_close_once
planned_test.assertion: A live file/iterator survives collection, unreachable resources close once, and runtime close leaves no service root.

owner.current: Fixed marking exists and Runtime shutdown destroy_all releases fixed objects last with a live StringPool, but no Runtime fixed-string owner initializes the required set.
owner.target: GlobalRoots owns fixed metamethod/error strings and Heap shutdown explicitly destroys them last.

tracer.current: Fixed bits prevent sweep, but no runtime root inventory initializes or traces the required set.
tracer.target: RuntimeRootTracer labels fixed strings; Heap::destroy_all frees them after ordinary objects.

root_kinds.missing_risk: Required emergency strings and their tracing owner are absent; standalone GarbageCollector Drop still lacks a StringPool even though Runtime close reclaims fixed objects.

planned_test.name: destroy_all_drops_every_layout_thread_first_and_fixed_last
planned_test.assertion: A fixed interned string is destroyed only in the fixed pass, removed from the live StringPool, and all collector accounting reaches zero.
